idea-plugin.name: pgfmt
idea-plugin.description:
Formats PostgreSQL .sql files with pgfmt, so that every editor on a team produces the same output.

Reformat Code, reformat on save, and reformat on commit run pgfmt in place of the built-in SQL formatter. pgfmt keeps :name placeholders, removes stray commas, checks that every statement means the same after formatting, and leaves any statement it cannot format exactly as written. A .pgfmt.json file in the project changes its settings.

The plugin requires the pgfmt executable, available through Homebrew: brew tap sirmspencer/tap && brew install pgfmt. Its location can be set under Settings | Tools | pgfmt.
